-- ── MAX_RAID_MEMBERS (ref RaidFrame.lua l.2) ───────────────────────────────────────── -- A fact about the protocol, not about our implementation: a 1.12 raid is 40, and the -- `raid1`..`raid40` token space is 40 wide whether or not we build a raid UI. Declared -- here rather than in a RaidFrame.xml because we ship none; party and raid are the same -- subsystem family, and this is the file that already owns the group surface. -- -- **The loop it feeds already works.** `for i = 1, MAX_RAID_MEMBERS do UnitName("raid"..i)` -- answers nil for every absent token, which is exactly right for a player not in a raid — -- so the constant is not a promise of a raid UI, it is the bound the token space has. -- -- Reached by following a `'for' limit must be a number` five addons shared: -- `CT_RaidAssist.lua:3283` is `for i = 1, MAX_RAID_MEMBERS, 1 do`. Read with `grep -a`, -- because this corpus's Ace files are ISO-8859 and plain grep silently skips them. MAX_RAID_MEMBERS = 40 -- Its two siblings, each reached one line further along the same chain -- (`CT_RAOptions.lua:75`, then `:231`). The reference declares all three together at -- RaidFrame.lua l.2-4, and they agree: 40 = 8 x 5. Adding them one at a time as an addon -- asked was the wrong shape — they are one fact about the raid token space, so they land -- as one. NUM_RAID_GROUPS = 8 MEMBERS_PER_RAID_GROUP = 5 -- The party's own bound (ref PartyMemberFrame.lua l.1) — four *other* members, so a full -- party sweep that includes the player runs `1, MAX_PARTY_MEMBERS+1`, which is exactly how -- GroupLootDropDown_Initialize walks the master-loot candidates (LootFrame.lua l.219). -- Published for the same reason as its raid siblings: the addon corpus reads it. MAX_PARTY_MEMBERS = 4
-- ── The group-invite popup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- The strings and the three flags are the reference's own (INVITATION = "%s invites you to -- a group.", GlobalStrings:2586-area; a 60 s silent timeout, answerable while dead, -- closable with ESC). -- -- The whole of its behaviour turns on ONE latch, `inviteAccepted`, and the four hooks below -- are just the four moments that read or write it. It lives on the registry entry rather -- than in an upvalue here because that is where the reference keeps it and an addon -- inspecting the dialog expects to find it there — which is why each hook goes back through -- `StaticPopupDialogs["PARTY_INVITE"]` instead of closing over a local. -- -- They are named rather than inlined so the entry below reads as the manifest it is: four -- strings, three flags, four hooks.
-- Every showing starts unanswered — including a re-show of the same entry, which is what a -- second invite arriving while the first is up does. local function PartyInvite_OnShow() StaticPopupDialogs["PARTY_INVITE"].inviteAccepted = nil end
-- The only path that answers the server affirmatively, and the only one that latches. local function PartyInvite_OnAccept() AcceptGroup() StaticPopupDialogs["PARTY_INVITE"].inviteAccepted = 1 end
local function PartyInvite_OnCancel() DeclineGroup() end
-- The catch-all. EVERY way this dialog leaves the screen lands here — Decline, the 60 s -- timeout, ESC, and another dialog overriding it — and the latch is what tells the one -- that already said yes from the four that never answered at all. A clicked Decline -- therefore declines twice (OnCancel, then here); see DOUBLE-DECLINE in the header, which -- is the reference's behaviour and the wire tolerates it. local function PartyInvite_OnHide() if not StaticPopupDialogs["PARTY_INVITE"].inviteAccepted then DeclineGroup() end end
StaticPopupDialogs["PARTY_INVITE"] = { text = INVITATION, button1 = ACCEPT, button2 = DECLINE, sound = "igPlayerInvite", timeout = 60, whileDead = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, OnShow = PartyInvite_OnShow, OnAccept = PartyInvite_OnAccept, OnCancel = PartyInvite_OnCancel, OnHide = PartyInvite_OnHide, }
-- ref PartyMemberFrame.lua's OnLoad: cache children, register, first paint. function BenillaPartyFrame_OnLoad(frame) local id = frame:GetID() local name = frame:GetName() local tf = name .. "TextureFrame" frame.unit = "party" .. id frame.portrait = getglobal(name .. "Portrait") frame.healthBar = getglobal(name .. "HealthBar") frame.manaBar = getglobal(name .. "ManaBar") -- The recessed-bar look, the reference's own mechanism (ref-TargetFrame.lua l.32-34): -- push the bars one frame level BELOW the art's TextureFrame. Frame level is the only -- key term above the draw layer (decision 0884), so this is the only thing that can hold -- the BACKGROUND party art over the ARTWORK bar fills. See the LAYERING note below. local textureFrameLevel = getglobal(tf):GetFrameLevel() frame.healthBar:SetFrameLevel(textureFrameLevel - 1) frame.manaBar:SetFrameLevel(textureFrameLevel - 1) frame.nameText = getglobal(tf .. "Name") frame.leaderIcon = getglobal(tf .. "LeaderIcon") frame.masterIcon = getglobal(tf .. "MasterIcon") frame.disconnect = getglobal(tf .. "Disconnect") frame.pvpIcon = getglobal(tf .. "PVPIcon") frame.flashTimer = 0 SetPortraitTexture(frame.portrait, frame.unit) frame:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD") frame:RegisterEvent("PARTY_MEMBERS_CHANGED") frame:RegisterEvent("PARTY_LEADER_CHANGED") frame:RegisterEvent("PARTY_LOOT_METHOD_CHANGED") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_HEALTH") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_MAXHEALTH") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_POWER_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_MAXPOWER") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_DISPLAYPOWER") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_NAME_UPDATE") frame:RegisterEvent("UNIT_FACTION") frame:EnableMouse(true) BenillaPartyFrame_Update(frame) end
function BenillaPartyFrame_OnEvent(frame) -- UNIT_* events name their unit in arg1; other units' updates are not ours. if string.sub(event, 1, 5) == "UNIT_" and arg1 ~= frame.unit then return end BenillaPartyFrame_Update(frame) end
-- ref PartyMemberHealthCheck: the portrait recolor law + the disconnect override. function BenillaPartyFrame_HealthCheck(frame) local unit = frame.unit if not UnitIsConnected(unit) then -- Disconnected: bar forced full and grey, portrait desaturated, icon on. frame.healthBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, 1) frame.healthBar:SetValue(1) frame.healthBar:SetStatusBarColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) SetDesaturation(frame.portrait, 1) frame.disconnect:Show() return end SetDesaturation(frame.portrait, nil) frame.disconnect:Hide() frame.healthBar:SetStatusBarColor(0.0, 1.0, 0.0) local hp, hpMax = UnitHealth(unit), UnitHealthMax(unit) if UnitIsDead(unit) then frame.portrait:SetVertexColor(0.35, 0.35, 0.35, 1.0) elseif UnitIsGhost(unit) then frame.portrait:SetVertexColor(0.2, 0.2, 0.75, 1.0) elseif hpMax > 0 and hp / hpMax <= 0.2 then frame.portrait:SetVertexColor(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0) else frame.portrait:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) end end
function BenillaPartyFrame_Update(frame) local unit = frame.unit if not UnitExists(unit) then frame:Hide() return end frame:Show()
frame.nameText:SetText(UnitName(unit) or "Unknown")
frame.healthBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, UnitHealthMax(unit)) frame.healthBar:SetValue(UnitHealth(unit))
local maxPower = UnitManaMax(unit) if maxPower > 0 then frame.manaBar:Show() local _, token = UnitPowerType(unit) local c = BENILLA_POWER_COLORS[token] or BENILLA_POWER_COLORS.MANA frame.manaBar:SetStatusBarColor(c.r, c.g, c.b) frame.manaBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, maxPower) frame.manaBar:SetValue(UnitMana(unit)) else frame.manaBar:Hide() end
-- Leader + master-looter icons (ref: GetPartyLeaderIndex / GetLootMethod vs own id). local id = frame:GetID() if GetPartyLeaderIndex() == id then frame.leaderIcon:Show() else frame.leaderIcon:Hide() end local lootMethod, masterId = GetLootMethod() if lootMethod == "master" and masterId == id then frame.masterIcon:Show() else frame.masterIcon:Hide() end
BenillaPartyFrame_HealthCheck(frame) BenillaPartyFrame_UpdatePvP(frame) end
-- ref PartyMemberFrame_UpdatePvPStatus (PartyMemberFrame.lua l.116-130), verbatim: the -- same three branches the unit frames run, but the faction leg draws the GroupFrame art -- (UI-Group-PVP-<group>) — only the FFA skull is shared with the big frames, because no -- UI-Group-PVP-FFA ships. Decision 0646 §4; closes 0434's named deferral (the icon waited -- on UnitFactionGroup, which the app now feeds). function BenillaPartyFrame_UpdatePvP(frame) local unit = frame.unit local factionGroup = UnitFactionGroup(unit) if UnitIsPVPFreeForAll(unit) then frame.pvpIcon:SetTexture("Interface\\TargetingFrame\\UI-PVP-FFA") frame.pvpIcon:Show() elseif factionGroup and UnitIsPVP(unit) then frame.pvpIcon:SetTexture("Interface\\GroupFrame\\UI-Group-PVP-" .. factionGroup) frame.pvpIcon:Show() else frame.pvpIcon:Hide() end end
-- The ref's <=20% portrait alpha pulse: a 0.5 s-per-leg triangle between 127/255 and 1. function BenillaPartyFrame_OnUpdate(frame, elapsed) local unit = frame.unit if not UnitExists(unit) or not UnitIsConnected(unit) then return end local hp, hpMax = UnitHealth(unit), UnitHealthMax(unit) if hpMax > 0 and hp > 0 and hp / hpMax <= 0.2 then local t = mod(frame.flashTimer + elapsed, 1.0) frame.flashTimer = t local a if t < 0.5 then a = 1.0 - t * (1.0 - 127 / 255) * 2 else a = 127 / 255 + (t - 0.5) * (1.0 - 127 / 255) * 2 end frame.portrait:SetAlpha(a) elseif frame.flashTimer ~= 0 then frame.flashTimer = 0 frame.portrait:SetAlpha(1.0) end end
-- The hover tooltip: same law as the unit frames (default corner anchor + SetUnit). function BenillaPartyFrame_OnEnter(frame) if not UnitExists(frame.unit) then return end GameTooltip_SetDefaultAnchor(GameTooltip, frame) if GameTooltip:SetUnit(frame.unit) then getglobal("GameTooltipTextLeft1"):SetTextColor(GameTooltip_UnitColor(frame.unit)) end end
-- The invite driver (ref UIParent.lua): PARTY_INVITE_REQUEST shows the popup with the -- inviter's name; PARTY_INVITE_CANCEL hides it. function BenillaPartyInviteDriver_OnEvent() if event == "PARTY_INVITE_REQUEST" then StaticPopup_Show("PARTY_INVITE", arg1) elseif event == "PARTY_INVITE_CANCEL" then StaticPopup_Hide("PARTY_INVITE") end end
-- The right-click dropdown (decision 0434 phase 5; ref PartyMemberFrame.lua l.369-381) -- + the ref's click law (l.226-237): left targets the member, right opens the PARTY -- menu seated at the frame's (47, 15). function PartyFrameDropDown_OnLoad() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(this, PartyFrameDropDown_Initialize, "MENU") end
function PartyFrameDropDown_Initialize() local dropdown if UIDROPDOWNMENU_OPEN_MENU then dropdown = getglobal(UIDROPDOWNMENU_OPEN_MENU) else dropdown = this end UnitPopup_ShowMenu(dropdown, "PARTY", "party" .. dropdown:GetParent():GetID()) end
function BenillaPartyFrame_OnClick(frame, button) if button == "LeftButton" then TargetUnit(frame.unit) elseif button == "RightButton" then ToggleDropDownMenu(1, nil, getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "DropDown"), frame:GetName(), 47, 15) end end
